cold_curve.uncertainty: Monte Carlo; confidence convention and covariance not specified

printed_surrogate.equations: (37)-(40), p. 055313-5; powers of absolute T in K

blockers: The four longitudinal/shear velocity-density linear regression coefficients needed for Poisson ratio and Debye temperature are not printed. Recovering a new regression from Ikuta data would be a declared reconstruction, not a reproduction of the authors coefficients.

Equation (40) prints negative linear and quadratic volume coefficients, giving negative zero-pressure thermal expansivity throughout the quoted domain. No author correction was located; no sign change is applied.
Equation (6) prints ln(1-exp(chi)) although chi=Theta/T is positive, giving a non-real entropy; the physical negative exponent is an interpretation, not the printed equation.
Equation (7) prints h where the angular-wavevector convention requires hbar; electronic beta0 units printed in prose also conflict with Cv=beta*T.
Gold comparison only reports K0=133.96 and Kprime=6.05, without its cold reference volume and complete material-specific thermal inputs.
scope: Title says 130 GPa, abstract/body say 140 GPa, both with 3200 K; comparisons extrapolate to 500 GPa. These are not a common experimental rectangle.
availability: Both PDF and local publisher snapshot checked. The paper supplies no observation table, numerical velocity regressions, source code, or supplement; its data-availability statement says data sharing is not applicable. Public correction search did not locate an erratum.

reference.title: Accurate equation of state of rhenium as pressure scale up to 130 GPa and 3200 K
